spanish_text: El actual alcalde de Barranquilla aseguró que el contrato del alumbrado público no se renovó por falta de recursos y no por presiones políticas, como pretenden sus opositores.
errors_to_catch: no por presiones políticas contrast lost
why_this_chunk: Two textbook false friends (actual, pretender) inside a normal city-hall news sentence, plus a polarity contrast that is easy to flatten.
suggested_ok_english_hint: The current mayor … not renewed for lack of funds … as his opponents claim/allege.
english_key: The current mayor of Barranquilla said the street lighting contract was not renewed because of a lack of funds, not because of political pressure, as his opponents claim.

traps.comment: actual = current / present. 'Actual mayor' means the real one, which changes the meaning.
traps.label: actual rendered as actual (≠ current)

traps.comment: pretender here = claim / maintain / would have people believe. 'Pretend' means to feign.
traps.label: pretenden rendered as pretend (≠ claim)

traps.comment: The source contrasts two causes (lack of funds, NOT political pressure). Dropping the 'not' half reverses or loses the claim.
traps.label: no por presiones políticas contrast lost

spanish_text: Según la federación, el suceso que más afectó a los pequeños caficultores del Huila este año fue la helada de julio, que dejó cosechas enteras sin valor comercial.
why_this_chunk: suceso→success is a high-frequency T error; helada and caficultores add Colombian agri lexicon.
suggested_ok_english_hint: …the event/incident that hit small coffee growers in Huila hardest … the July frost …
english_key: According to the federation, the event that hit small coffee growers in Huila hardest this year was the July frost, which left entire harvests with no commercial value.

traps.comment: suceso = event / incident. 'Success' is éxito. This inverts the meaning of the sentence.
traps.label: suceso rendered as success

traps.comment: helada = frost / freeze (crop damage), not 'ice cream' or 'ice'.
traps.label: helada not rendered as frost/freeze

traps.comment: caficultores = coffee growers/farmers. Keep the coffee sense; 'small farmers' alone drops it.
traps.label: caficultores → coffee growers

spanish_text: Mi hija terminó el colegio en Bucaramanga y ahora estudia la carrera de Derecho en una universidad pública; dice que la facultad exige mucha más lectura de la que imaginaba.
why_this_chunk: Three education false friends in one natural sentence (colegio, carrera, lectura) — the classic US-target cluster.
suggested_ok_english_hint: …finished high school … is studying law … much more reading than she expected.
english_key: My daughter finished high school in Bucaramanga and is now studying law at a public university; she says the law school requires much more reading than she imagined.
acceptables: My daughter graduated from high school in Bucaramanga and is now studying law at a public university; she says the school requires much more reading than she imagined.

traps.comment: colegio = (primary/secondary) school; terminar el colegio = finish high school. 'College' is university-level in US English.
traps.label: colegio rendered as college

traps.comment: estudiar la carrera de Derecho = study law / be in a law degree program. 'Career' is a working life.
traps.no: is studying the career of law
traps.label: carrera rendered as career

traps.comment: lectura = reading. A lecture is a clase magistral / conferencia.
traps.label: lectura rendered as lecture

spanish_text: La decepción de los vecinos fue evidente cuando la empresa de acueducto avisó, con apenas un día de anticipación, que suspendería el servicio de agua todo el fin de semana.
errors_to_catch: empresa de acueducto rendered as aqueduct
why_this_chunk: decepción / avisar are frequent FF hits; empresa de acueducto is Colombian utility lexicon that tempts 'aqueduct company'.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Residents' disappointment … the water utility gave notice, only a day in advance, …
english_key: Residents' disappointment was obvious when the water utility announced, with only one day's notice, that it would cut off water service for the entire weekend.
acceptables: The residents' disappointment was obvious when the water company announced, with only one day's notice, that it would cut off water service for the entire weekend.

traps.comment: decepción = disappointment. 'Deception' is engaño.
traps.label: decepción rendered as deception

traps.comment: avisar = notify / announce / let people know. 'Advised' implies recommending.
traps.label: avisó rendered as advised

traps.comment: In Colombia la empresa de acueducto = the water utility / water company. 'Aqueduct' suggests a Roman structure.
traps.label: empresa de acueducto rendered as aqueduct

spanish_text: Durante la sesión, los concejales discutieron por más de tres horas la posibilidad de implementar un cobro por congestión en el centro histórico de Cartagena; al final, la propuesta fue aplazada sin votación.
why_this_chunk: discutir/aplazar are FF-adjacent verbs whose wrong choice changes the outcome; adds a policy term.
suggested_ok_english_hint: …council members debated … a congestion charge … the proposal was postponed without a vote.
english_key: During the session, council members debated for more than three hours the possibility of introducing a congestion charge in Cartagena's historic center; in the end, the proposal was postponed without a vote.

traps.comment: discutir in a council session = debate / discuss. Bare 'argued' reads as quarreling.
traps.no: the council members argued for three hours
traps.label: discutieron rendered as argued

traps.comment: aplazada = postponed. 'Approved' or 'applauded' reverses the outcome.
traps.label: aplazada not rendered as postponed

traps.comment: US target: center, not centre.
traps.label: centre for center

spanish_text: La convocatoria exige que las y los docentes presenten su título profesional y una constancia de experiencia laboral antes del 15 de noviembre.
why_this_chunk: Inclusive doubling (las y los docentes) plus three paperwork false friends: convocatoria, título, constancia.
suggested_ok_english_hint: The call for applications requires teachers to submit their degree and a letter/certificate of experience by November 15.
english_key: The call for applications requires teachers to submit their professional degree and a certificate of work experience by November 15.
acceptables: The call for applications requires teachers to submit their professional degree and proof of work experience by November 15.

traps.comment: convocatoria = call for applications / hiring call / open competition. A convocation is a ceremony or assembly.
traps.label: convocatoria rendered as convocation

traps.comment: constancia = certificate / letter / proof. Constancy is perseverance.
traps.label: constancia rendered as constancy

traps.comment: Spanish doubles the article for inclusivity; natural US English uses the gender-neutral noun (teachers).
traps.label: las y los docentes calqued

spanish_text: Más de dos mil jóvenes aplicaron a la beca de la gobernación, pero solo 150 la obtuvieron; los demás podrán volver a postularse en el siguiente ciclo.
errors_to_catch: applied to the scholarship (≠ applied for)
why_this_chunk: U-bank preposition trap (apply FOR a scholarship), a quantity, and Colombian gobernación.
suggested_ok_english_hint: More than 2,000 young people applied for the … scholarship … the rest can reapply next cycle.
english_key: More than 2,000 young people applied for the provincial government scholarship, but only 150 received it; the rest will be able to reapply in the next cycle.
acceptables: More than 2,000 young people applied for the governor's office scholarship, but only 150 got it; the rest will be able to reapply in the next cycle.

traps.comment: In US English you apply FOR a scholarship/grant (apply TO a school).
traps.label: applied to the scholarship (≠ applied for)

traps.comment: gobernación = the departmental (provincial/state-level) government. Dropping it loses who funds the scholarship.
traps.label: gobernación omitted or mistranslated

traps.comment: dos mil must come through as 2,000 / two thousand.
traps.label: dos mil lost

spanish_text: El Gobierno radicó ante el Congreso un proyecto de ley que reduciría gradualmente la jornada laboral de 48 a 42 horas semanales, sin disminución del salario.
errors_to_catch: proyecto de ley rendered as law project
why_this_chunk: radicar / proyecto de ley / jornada laboral are LatAm legislative staples that get calqued.
suggested_ok_english_hint: The government submitted/filed a bill … reduce the workweek from 48 to 42 hours … with no pay cut.
english_key: The government filed a bill in Congress that would gradually reduce the workweek from 48 to 42 hours, with no cut in pay.
acceptables: The government submitted a bill to Congress that would gradually cut the workweek from 48 to 42 hours without reducing wages.

traps.comment: radicar un proyecto = file / submit / introduce a bill.
traps.label: radicó calqued

traps.comment: proyecto de ley = bill.
traps.label: proyecto de ley rendered as law project

traps.comment: US target: labor, not labour.
traps.label: labour for labor

spanish_text: En Rosario, muchos inquilinos ya no pagan el alquiler en pesos: el propietario exige dólares billete, y las expensas del edificio se ajustan cada tres meses según el índice de precios.
why_this_chunk: Argentine housing lexicon (expensas, dólares billete) where the cognate guess is wrong.
suggested_ok_english_hint: …tenants … landlords demand cash (US) dollars … the building's maintenance/HOA fees …
english_key: In Rosario, many tenants no longer pay rent in pesos: landlords demand cash dollars, and the building's maintenance fees are adjusted every three months based on the price index.
acceptables: In Rosario, many tenants no longer pay their rent in pesos: the owner demands US dollar bills, and the building's maintenance fees are adjusted every three months according to the price index.

traps.comment: Argentina: expensas = building maintenance fees / HOA dues, not generic 'expenses'.
traps.label: expensas rendered as expenses

traps.comment: dólares billete = physical US dollar bills (cash), as opposed to dollars in an account.
traps.label: dólares billete flattened to dollars

traps.comment: índice de precios = price index (indexation mechanism). Don't paraphrase it away.
traps.label: índice de precios lost

spanish_text: El aguinaldo llega en junio y diciembre, pero para quienes trabajan como monotributistas no existe: cobran contra factura y, si se enferman, simplemente no facturan.
why_this_chunk: Two Argentine labor terms with no one-word US equivalent; tests explanation vs. calque.
suggested_ok_english_hint: The extra month's pay/semiannual bonus … self-employed (simplified-tax) contractors … paid on invoice …
english_key: The extra month's pay arrives in June and December, but for people who work as self-employed contractors it does not exist: they get paid when they invoice, and if they get sick, they simply don't bill.
acceptables: The year-end bonus comes in June and December, but for those who work as self-employed contractors it doesn't exist: they are paid against invoices and, if they get sick, they simply don't invoice.

traps.comment: aguinaldo = mandatory extra month's salary paid in two installments (June/December). Leaving 'aguinaldo' bare is opaque to a US reader.
traps.ok: the semiannual bonus / extra month's pay
traps.label: aguinaldo left untranslated/unexplained

traps.comment: monotributistas = self-employed workers under Argentina's simplified tax regime. 'Monotributists' is not English.
traps.label: monotributistas calqued

traps.comment: Do not leave the coined term in English text without a gloss.
traps.label: monotribut- left in English

spanish_text: Los vecinos de la colonia Narvarte pidieron a la alcaldía Benito Juárez más patrullas, pues los asaltos en el camión de la ruta 7 aumentaron desde que cerraron la estación del metro.
why_this_chunk: Mexico City lexicon (colonia, alcaldía, camión) where every cognate guess is wrong.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Residents of the Narvarte neighborhood … Benito Juárez borough … robberies on the Route 7 bus …
english_key: Residents of the Narvarte neighborhood asked the Benito Juárez borough government for more patrols, since holdups on the Route 7 bus have increased since the subway station closed.
acceptables: Residents of the Narvarte neighborhood asked the Benito Juárez borough for more patrols because robberies on the Route 7 bus have gone up since the metro station closed.

traps.comment: Mexico: colonia = neighborhood / district.
traps.label: colonia rendered as colony

traps.comment: Mexico: camión (de pasajeros) = bus. 'Truck' is wrong in this context (ruta 7).
traps.label: camión rendered as truck

traps.comment: Keep the borough's proper name.
traps.label: Benito Juárez omitted

spanish_text: En los barrios de estratos uno y dos de Cali, la tarifa del gas subió casi 9%, mientras que los hogares de estrato seis pagan una contribución adicional que subsidia a los demás.
why_this_chunk: Colombian estrato system needs a reader-friendly rendering; adds an easy-to-drop intensifier (casi).
suggested_ok_english_hint: In Cali's lowest-income (socioeconomic level 1 and 2) neighborhoods … nearly 9% … level 6 households …
english_key: In Cali's socioeconomic level 1 and 2 neighborhoods, the gas rate rose almost 9%, while level 6 households pay an additional surcharge that subsidizes everyone else.

traps.comment: estrato = Colombia's socioeconomic tier for utility billing. Render it so a US reader understands (socioeconomic level/stratum).
traps.label: estrato left bare or lost

traps.comment: casi 9% ≠ 9%. Dropping the hedge changes the figure.
traps.label: casi dropped before 9%

traps.comment: US target: subsidize, not subsidise.
traps.label: subsidise for subsidize

spanish_text: “Uno sale a las cinco de la mañana, se toma un tinto en la esquina y coge la buseta, porque si espera el SITP llega tarde”, contó un vigilante del barrio Kennedy.
errors_to_catch: tinto rendered as red wine / left bare
why_this_chunk: Bogotá street register inside quotes: tinto, buseta, vigilante (FF), impersonal uno, US quote punctuation.
suggested_ok_english_hint: "You leave at five … grab a coffee on the corner and catch the minibus … ," said a security guard …
english_key: "You leave at five in the morning, grab a black coffee on the corner, and catch the minibus, because if you wait for the SITP, you're late," said a security guard from the Kennedy neighborhood.
acceptables: "You head out at 5 a.m., have a black coffee on the corner, and catch the minibus, because if you wait for the SITP, you get there late," said a security guard from the Kennedy neighborhood.

traps.comment: vigilante = security guard / watchman. In English a vigilante takes the law into their own hands.
traps.label: vigilante kept as vigilante

traps.comment: Colombia: un tinto = a (small) black coffee, not red wine.
traps.label: tinto rendered as red wine / left bare

traps.comment: US punctuation: comma inside the closing quote before the speech tag; no Spanish « » or comma outside.
traps.label: comma outside closing quote

spanish_text: Sería ingenuo suponer que la brecha educativa entre el campo y la ciudad se cerrará por sí sola; sin una inversión sostenida en docentes rurales, cualquier reforma quedará en el papel.
why_this_chunk: Formal essay register with an idiom (quedar en el papel) and campo/ciudad that tempts 'field'.
suggested_ok_english_hint: It would be naive to assume … between rural and urban areas … any reform will remain on paper / a dead letter.
english_key: It would be naive to assume that the education gap between rural and urban areas will close on its own; without sustained investment in rural teachers, any reform will exist only on paper.
acceptables: It would be naive to assume that the educational gap between the countryside and the cities will close by itself; without sustained investment in rural teachers, any reform will remain on paper.

traps.comment: el campo vs la ciudad = rural areas / the countryside vs cities.
traps.no: between the field and the city
traps.label: campo rendered as field

traps.comment: quedar en el papel = exist only on paper / never be implemented.
traps.label: quedará en el papel calqued

traps.comment: Formal essay register: avoid contractions the source tone does not invite.
traps.ok: it would be naive … will exist
traps.label: contractions in formal essay

spanish_text: Si notas un cobro que no reconoces, bloquea tu tarjeta desde la aplicación y comunícate con nosotros; nunca te pediremos tu clave por mensaje de texto ni por correo.
why_this_chunk: Consumer tú register → plain US 'you' prose; cobro and clave are sense traps.
suggested_ok_english_hint: If you see a charge you don't recognize, lock your card in the app … we'll never ask for your PIN/password …
english_key: If you see a charge you don't recognize, lock your card in the app and contact us; we will never ask for your PIN by text message or email.
acceptables: If you notice a charge you don't recognize, block your card from the app and contact us; we will never ask for your password by text message or email.

traps.comment: tú consumer copy → direct, plain US 'you'. Stiff or third-person framing changes the register.
traps.no: Should the user notice a charge…
traps.label: stiff register for tú copy

traps.comment: clave (bank context) = PIN / password, not 'key'.
traps.label: clave rendered as key

traps.comment: un cobro que no reconoces = a charge you don't recognize; 'collection' implies debt collection.
traps.label: cobro rendered as collection

spanish_text: Se informa a la comunidad educativa que, por razones de fuerza mayor, las clases presenciales quedan suspendidas hasta nuevo aviso y continuarán de manera virtual.
errors_to_catch: hasta nuevo aviso not rendered as until further notice
fuerza mayor → force majeure in a school notice
why_this_chunk: Institutional notice register: plain-but-formal US, not legalese; presencial/fuerza mayor are calque magnets.
suggested_ok_english_hint: …due to circumstances beyond our control, in-person classes are suspended until further notice and will continue online.
english_key: The school community is advised that, due to circumstances beyond our control, in-person classes are suspended until further notice and will continue online.
acceptables: We wish to inform the school community that, for reasons beyond our control, in-person classes are suspended until further notice and will continue online.

traps.comment: clases presenciales = in-person classes. 'Presential' is not standard English.
traps.label: presenciales rendered as presential

traps.comment: hasta nuevo aviso has a fixed equivalent: until further notice.
traps.label: hasta nuevo aviso not rendered as until further notice

traps.comment: School notice: 'circumstances beyond our control' reads naturally; 'force majeure' is contract legalese.
traps.label: fuerza mayor → force majeure in a school notice

spanish_text: No se trata de satanizar el endeudamiento, sino de entender que un crédito mal calculado puede convertirse, en cuestión de meses, en una bola de nieve difícil de detener.
why_this_chunk: Opinion register: no se trata de… sino de… structure, a loaded verb (satanizar), and an idiom that transfers.
suggested_ok_english_hint: The point is not to demonize borrowing but to understand … a snowball that is hard to stop.
english_key: The point is not to demonize debt but to understand that a poorly calculated loan can, within a matter of months, become a snowball that is hard to stop.
acceptables: This is not a matter of demonizing debt but of understanding that a badly calculated loan can, in a matter of months, turn into a snowball that is hard to stop.

traps.comment: satanizar = demonize. 'Satanize' is unidiomatic in US English.
traps.label: satanizar calqued

traps.comment: No se trata de X sino de Y — both halves must survive: 'The point is not X but Y'. Dropping the sino-half is an omission.
traps.ok: The point is not to demonize debt but to understand…
traps.no: We should not demonize debt. A loan can become a snowball…
traps.label: sino half dropped

traps.comment: en cuestión de meses — the time frame is part of the warning.
traps.label: en cuestión de meses omitted

spanish_text: El Ministerio de Hacienda estima que el recaudo adicional de la reforma tributaria rondará los 12 billones de pesos en 2027, una cifra que varios analistas consideran optimista.
why_this_chunk: billón = trillion is the highest-cost money trap in ES→EN; plus Hacienda institution name.
suggested_ok_english_hint: The Finance Ministry estimates … additional revenue … around 12 trillion pesos …
english_key: The Finance Ministry estimates that the additional revenue from the tax reform will be around 12 trillion pesos in 2027, a figure that several analysts consider optimistic.
acceptables: The Ministry of Finance estimates that the additional revenue from the tax reform will reach about 12 trillion pesos in 2027, a figure several analysts consider optimistic.

traps.comment: Spanish billón = 10^12 = US trillion. '12 billion' is off by a factor of 1,000.
traps.label: billones rendered as billion

traps.comment: The amount must come through as 12 trillion.
traps.label: 12 billones amount missing

traps.comment: Ministerio de Hacienda = Finance Ministry / Ministry of Finance (Treasury). Don't leave 'Hacienda' in English.
traps.label: Ministerio de Hacienda left untranslated

spanish_text: Banxico recortó la tasa de interés objetivo en 25 puntos base, a 7,25%, y advirtió que la inflación subyacente sigue por encima de su meta de 3% más/menos un punto porcentual.
errors_to_catch: subyacente not rendered as core inflation
why_this_chunk: Central-bank precision: basis points, decimal comma, core inflation, percentage point.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Banxico cut its target rate by 25 basis points, to 7.25% … core inflation … 3% plus or minus one percentage point.
english_key: Banxico cut its target interest rate by 25 basis points, to 7.25%, and warned that core inflation remains above its target of 3% plus or minus one percentage point.
acceptables: Banxico lowered its target interest rate by 25 basis points to 7.25% and warned that core inflation is still above its 3% target, plus or minus one percentage point.
The Bank of Mexico cut its target interest rate by 25 basis points, to 7.25%, and warned that core inflation remains above its target of 3% plus or minus one percentage point.

traps.comment: Spanish decimal comma → US decimal point: 7.25%.
traps.label: 7,25 left with a comma

traps.comment: inflación subyacente = core inflation (standard central-bank term).
traps.label: subyacente not rendered as core inflation

traps.comment: puntos base = basis points (0.25 pp), not 'base points'.
traps.label: puntos base mistranslated

spanish_text: La tasa de desempleo pasó de 10,2% a 9,6% en un año; es decir, bajó 0,6 puntos porcentuales, y no 6%, como tituló erróneamente un diario regional.
why_this_chunk: Percent vs percentage points is a Meaning error graders punish; stacked decimal commas.
suggested_ok_english_hint: …from 10.2% to 9.6% … fell 0.6 percentage points, not 6%, as a regional paper wrongly headlined.
english_key: The unemployment rate went from 10.2% to 9.6% in one year; in other words, it fell 0.6 percentage points, not 6%, as a regional newspaper mistakenly reported in a headline.

traps.comment: puntos porcentuales = percentage points. Writing '0.6%' or 'points' alone confuses relative and absolute change — the whole point of the sentence.
traps.label: puntos porcentuales rendered as percent

traps.comment: All three Spanish decimal commas become US decimal points (10.2, 9.6, 0.6).
traps.label: decimal comma left in English

traps.comment: erróneamente carries the writer's judgment; dropping it is an omission.
traps.ok: as a regional newspaper mistakenly reported
traps.label: erróneamente omitted

spanish_text: Las remesas que reciben los hogares colombianos superaron los US$11.800 millones el año pasado, el equivalente a cerca del 2,8% del PIB.
why_this_chunk: millones with thousands point → billions in English; decimal comma; PIB → GDP.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Remittances … exceeded US$11.8 billion … about 2.8% of GDP.
english_key: Remittances received by Colombian households exceeded US$11.8 billion last year, the equivalent of about 2.8% of GDP.
acceptables: Remittances received by Colombian households topped $11.8 billion last year, equivalent to about 2.8% of GDP.
Remittances received by Colombian households exceeded US$11,800 million last year, equivalent to nearly 2.8% of GDP.

traps.comment: US$11.800 millones = US$11.8 billion (or 11,800 million). The Spanish thousands point is not a decimal.
traps.label: 11.800 millones mis-scaled

traps.comment: PIB = GDP in English.
traps.label: PIB left untranslated

spanish_text: El sismo, de magnitud 6,1 y con epicentro a 30 kilómetros de Los Santos (Santander), se sintió en Bogotá; el Servicio Geológico Colombiano no reportó muertos, pero sí daños en viviendas de bahareque.
why_this_chunk: Science/news precision: decimal comma in magnitude, institution name, a regional building term, and a parenthetical department.
suggested_ok_english_hint: The magnitude 6.1 quake, centered 30 kilometers from Los Santos (Santander) … Colombian Geological Survey … wattle-and-daub houses.
english_key: The magnitude 6.1 earthquake, centered 30 kilometers from Los Santos (Santander), was felt in Bogotá; the Colombian Geological Survey reported no deaths but did report damage to wattle-and-daub homes.
acceptables: The 6.1-magnitude earthquake, with its epicenter 30 kilometers from Los Santos (Santander), was felt in Bogotá; the Colombian Geological Survey reported no deaths but did report damage to bahareque (wattle-and-daub) houses.

traps.comment: Magnitude 6,1 → 6.1.
traps.label: 6,1 left with a comma

traps.comment: bahareque = wattle-and-daub (cane/bamboo frame with mud). Don't drop the building type — it explains the damage.
traps.label: bahareque dropped

traps.comment: US target: kilometers.
traps.label: kilometres for kilometers

spanish_text: En el ensayo clínico, la mitad de los participantes recibió la vacuna y la otra mitad un placebo; la eficacia fue del 71,4% (intervalo de confianza del 95%: 63,0–78,1).
why_this_chunk: Science precision: ensayo clínico, CI notation, and three decimal commas inside a parenthetical.
suggested_ok_english_hint: In the clinical trial … efficacy was 71.4% (95% confidence interval: 63.0–78.1).
english_key: In the clinical trial, half of the participants received the vaccine and the other half a placebo; efficacy was 71.4% (95% confidence interval: 63.0–78.1).

traps.comment: ensayo clínico = clinical trial, not essay or test.
traps.label: ensayo clínico rendered as essay/test

traps.comment: intervalo de confianza = confidence interval.
traps.label: intervalo de confianza mistranslated

spanish_text: Los resultados preliminares sugieren, aunque no demuestran, que el consumo frecuente de bebidas azucaradas se asocia con un mayor riesgo de hígado graso en adolescentes.
why_this_chunk: Scientific hedging must survive: sugieren/no demuestran/se asocia — overstating causality is a Meaning error.
suggested_ok_english_hint: Preliminary results suggest, though they do not prove, … is associated with a higher risk of fatty liver …
english_key: The preliminary results suggest, though they do not prove, that frequent consumption of sugary drinks is associated with a higher risk of fatty liver in adolescents.
acceptables: Preliminary results suggest, but do not prove, that frequent consumption of sugar-sweetened beverages is linked to a higher risk of fatty liver in teenagers.

traps.comment: aunque no demuestran is the key hedge; dropping it overstates the evidence.
traps.ok: suggest, though they do not prove,
traps.label: aunque no demuestran omitted

traps.comment: se asocia con = is associated with / is linked to. 'Causes' asserts causality the source denies.
traps.label: se asocia rendered as causal

traps.comment: hígado graso = fatty liver (disease).
traps.label: hígado graso mistranslated

spanish_text: Según el último informe de las pruebas Saber 11, apenas uno de cada cinco estudiantes de colegios oficiales alcanzó el nivel satisfactorio en lectura crítica.
errors_to_catch: colegios oficiales rendered as official schools
why_this_chunk: Colombian test name, colegios oficiales (public schools), apenas as an intensifier that's easy to drop.
suggested_ok_english_hint: According to the latest Saber 11 report, only one in five public-school students …
english_key: According to the latest Saber 11 report, only one in five students at public schools reached the satisfactory level in critical reading.
acceptables: According to the latest report on the Saber 11 exams, just one in five public school students reached the satisfactory level in critical reading.

traps.comment: colegios oficiales = public (state) schools.
traps.label: colegios oficiales rendered as official schools

traps.comment: apenas is the point of the sentence (only one in five).
traps.label: apenas omitted

traps.comment: Keep the exam's proper name (Saber 11); optional gloss: Colombia's national high school exit exam.
traps.label: Saber 11 dropped

spanish_text: La ministra de Educación, Liliana Restrepo Arango, se reunió el lunes con la rectora de la Universidad Nacional y con el gobernador del Cauca para hablar del regreso a la presencialidad.
errors_to_catch: Governor of Cauca capped without a name
why_this_chunk: Title-before-name caps vs. office-alone lowercase, rectora→university president, presencialidad calque (invented officials).
suggested_ok_english_hint: Education Minister Liliana Restrepo Arango met Monday with the president of the National University and the governor of Cauca …
english_key: Education Minister Liliana Restrepo Arango met on Monday with the president of the National University and the governor of Cauca to discuss the return to in-person classes.
acceptables: The education minister, Liliana Restrepo Arango, met on Monday with the president of the National University and the governor of Cauca to discuss the return to in-person classes.
Education Minister Liliana Restrepo Arango met Monday with the rector of the National University and the governor of Cauca to discuss the return to in-person learning.

traps.comment: Title directly before the name is capitalized (Education Minister Liliana Restrepo Arango). Set off by commas, lowercase is fine: 'the education minister, Liliana…'.
traps.label: education minister lowercase before name

traps.comment: Office alone (no name following) stays lowercase in US style: the governor of Cauca.
traps.label: Governor of Cauca capped without a name

traps.comment: regreso a la presencialidad = return to in-person classes/learning.
traps.label: presencialidad calqued

spanish_text: En conferencia de prensa, el jefe de Gabinete anunció que el Banco Central dejará de financiar al Tesoro, aunque no precisó a partir de qué mes regirá la medida.
errors_to_catch: jefe de Gabinete rendered as chief of staff
why_this_chunk: Argentine institution titles (jefe de Gabinete ≠ chief of staff), Treasury/Central Bank caps, precisar FF.
suggested_ok_english_hint: At a press conference, the cabinet chief announced … stop financing the Treasury … did not specify which month …
english_key: At a press conference, the cabinet chief announced that the Central Bank will stop financing the Treasury, although he did not specify starting in which month the measure will take effect.
acceptables: At a press conference, the cabinet chief announced that the Central Bank will stop financing the Treasury, though he did not specify from which month the measure will apply.

traps.comment: Argentina's jefe de Gabinete (de Ministros) = cabinet chief / chief of the Cabinet of Ministers — a ministerial post, not a White House-style chief of staff.
traps.label: jefe de Gabinete rendered as chief of staff

traps.comment: no precisó = did not specify / did not say exactly.
traps.label: precisó rendered as precise

traps.comment: el Tesoro = the Treasury (the national treasury). Keep it — it's who stops getting financed.
traps.label: Tesoro omitted

spanish_text: Lo preocupante no es la cifra en sí, sino la tendencia: por tercer año consecutivo, aumenta la deserción escolar entre las niñas de las zonas rurales de Chiapas.
errors_to_catch: lo preocupante lost its noun head
why_this_chunk: Nominalized lo + adjective (POS job), deserción false friend, and a gender-specific noun that must NOT be neutralized.
suggested_ok_english_hint: What is worrying is not the figure itself but the trend: for the third year in a row, the school dropout rate among girls …
english_key: What is worrying is not the figure itself but the trend: for the third year in a row, school dropout among girls in rural Chiapas is rising.
acceptables: The worrying thing is not the number itself but the trend: for the third consecutive year, school dropout among girls in rural areas of Chiapas is increasing.

traps.comment: deserción escolar = school dropout (rate). Desertion is military.
traps.label: deserción rendered as desertion

traps.comment: niñas is specific: girls. 'Children' or 'students' erases the gender point of the sentence.
traps.label: niñas generalized to children

traps.comment: Lo preocupante = a noun-like head: 'What is worrying' / 'The worrying thing'. Bare 'Worrying is not…' loses the noun job.
traps.label: lo preocupante lost its noun head

spanish_text: La llegada del metro a Bogotá fue, durante más de setenta años, una promesa recurrente de campaña. Cada administración presentó estudios, diseños y maquetas; ninguna puso la primera piedra. Hoy, con las obras avanzadas sobre la avenida Primero de Mayo, el escepticismo de los bogotanos empieza a ceder, aunque muchos todavía dudan de que la primera línea esté lista a tiempo.
why_this_chunk: Cohesive mini-essay: idiom (poner la primera piedra), ceder FF, serial list, time span, concessive close.
suggested_ok_english_hint: For more than seventy years … none broke ground … skepticism is starting to fade, although many still doubt …
english_key: For more than seventy years, bringing a subway to Bogotá was a recurring campaign promise. Every administration presented studies, designs, and models; none broke ground. Today, with construction well along on Avenida Primero de Mayo, Bogotá residents' skepticism is beginning to fade, although many still doubt that the first line will be finished on time.
acceptables: For more than 70 years, the arrival of the metro in Bogotá was a recurring campaign promise. Each administration presented studies, designs, and scale models; none laid the cornerstone. Today, with work well advanced on Avenida Primero de Mayo, the skepticism of Bogotá residents is starting to ease, although many still doubt the first line will be ready on time.

traps.comment: poner la primera piedra = break ground / lay the cornerstone. 'Put the first stone' is a calque.
traps.label: puso la primera piedra calqued

traps.comment: ceder here = fade / ease / give way. 'Cede' means to hand over territory or rights.
traps.label: ceder rendered as cede

traps.comment: durante más de setenta años — the span is the hook of the paragraph.
traps.label: setenta años omitted

spanish_text: Un equipo de la UNAM documentó que el ajolote de Xochimilco, especie endémica en peligro crítico de extinción, sobrevive mejor en los canales donde los chinamperos han dejado de usar agroquímicos. Los investigadores advierten, sin embargo, que la población silvestre sigue siendo muy pequeña y que la mejora en la calidad del agua todavía no basta para revertir el declive.
errors_to_catch: en peligro crítico not rendered as critically endangered
why_this_chunk: Science paragraph with Mexican lexicon (ajolote, chinamperos), a conservation-status term, and a however-contrast.
suggested_ok_english_hint: A UNAM team documented that the Xochimilco axolotl, a critically endangered endemic species, … chinampa farmers … The researchers warn, however, …
english_key: A UNAM team documented that the Xochimilco axolotl, a critically endangered endemic species, survives better in canals where chinampa farmers have stopped using agrochemicals. The researchers warn, however, that the wild population remains very small and that the improvement in water quality is still not enough to reverse the decline.
acceptables: A team from UNAM documented that the Xochimilco axolotl, an endemic, critically endangered species, survives better in canals where chinampa farmers have stopped using agrochemicals. However, the researchers warn that the wild population is still very small and that the improvement in water quality is not yet enough to reverse the decline.

traps.comment: en peligro crítico de extinción = critically endangered (IUCN category). 'In critical danger of extinction' is a calque that loses the term of art.
traps.label: en peligro crítico not rendered as critically endangered

traps.comment: chinamperos = chinampa farmers (farmers of Xochimilco's floating gardens). Keep 'chinampa' — it's the place-specific term.
traps.label: chinamperos flattened to farmers

traps.comment: sin embargo signals the turn; dropping it loses the paragraph's logic.
traps.label: sin embargo omitted

spanish_text: Para muchas familias de clase media, el plazo fijo dejó de ser un refugio: con una inflación mensual de dos dígitos, los intereses no alcanzaban a cubrir la pérdida de poder adquisitivo. La alternativa fue comprar dólares en el mercado paralelo, el llamado dólar blue, pese a que la brecha con el tipo de cambio oficial superaba entonces el 100%.
errors_to_catch: tipo de cambio not rendered as exchange rate
why_this_chunk: Argentine personal-finance paragraph: plazo fijo, poder adquisitivo, dólar blue, brecha cambiaria — every term has a fixed English equivalent.
suggested_ok_english_hint: …the fixed-term deposit stopped being a safe haven … purchasing power … the so-called blue dollar … official exchange rate …
english_key: For many middle-class families, the fixed-term deposit stopped being a safe haven: with double-digit monthly inflation, the interest did not cover the loss of purchasing power. The alternative was to buy dollars on the parallel market, the so-called blue dollar, even though the gap with the official exchange rate exceeded 100% at the time.
acceptables: For many middle-class families, time deposits stopped being a refuge: with double-digit monthly inflation, interest wasn't enough to cover the loss of purchasing power. The alternative was buying dollars on the parallel market, the so-called "blue dollar," even though the gap with the official exchange rate was over 100% at the time.

traps.comment: plazo fijo = fixed-term (time) deposit / CD. 'Fixed term' alone or 'fixed deadline' misses the banking product.
traps.label: plazo fijo mistranslated

traps.comment: poder adquisitivo = purchasing power.
traps.label: poder adquisitivo mistranslated

traps.comment: tipo de cambio oficial = official exchange rate.
traps.label: tipo de cambio not rendered as exchange rate

spanish_text: En la vereda La Esperanza, a dos horas a lomo de mula de la cabecera municipal, la escuela tiene una sola maestra para veintitrés niños de seis grados distintos. “Aquí no hay internet, pero hay ganas”, dice ella, mientras reparte las guías que imprimió con su propio sueldo. La Secretaría de Educación departamental asegura que el nombramiento de un segundo docente está en trámite.
why_this_chunk: Colombian rural lexicon (vereda, cabecera municipal), a quote with US punctuation, and an office-vs-person title trap.
suggested_ok_english_hint: In the rural district of La Esperanza, two hours by mule from the town center … "…," she says … the departmental education office says …
english_key: In the rural district of La Esperanza, two hours by mule from the town center, the school has a single teacher for twenty-three children in six different grades. "There's no internet here, but there's determination," she says as she hands out the worksheets she printed with her own salary. The departmental Education Office says the appointment of a second teacher is in process.
acceptables: In the La Esperanza rural district, two hours by mule from the municipal seat, the school has only one teacher for twenty-three children in six different grades. "We don't have internet here, but we have drive," she says, while handing out the study guides she printed with her own salary. The departmental education department says the appointment of a second teacher is being processed.

traps.comment: Colombia: vereda = rural district / hamlet (administrative subdivision of a municipality). 'Sidewalk' is the Southern Cone sense and is wrong here.
traps.ok: In the rural district of La Esperanza
traps.label: vereda rendered as sidewalk

traps.comment: Secretaría de Educación = the education office/department (an agency), not the Secretary (a person).
traps.label: Secretaría rendered as Secretary

traps.comment: US punctuation: comma inside the closing quote before the speech tag.
traps.label: comma outside closing quote
